comparison.objective: Candidate separates mixed rigid bodies by screening; record unfolds and configures a laptop stand.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests granular-flow control and clearing orientation-dependent bridges; record tests articulated linkage spreading and seating two support rods into slots.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires mass recovery and selective retention without spill; record requires full spread, two rods in the highest slots, contained stable placement and release.
comparison.reason: Repeated insertion and articulated configuration test a different ability from selective particle passage through a screen.
